candidate_preparation.instruction_scope: User directed preparation and publication using the specified scientific choices; stop after delivery for review.

interpretation_contract.claim_to_test: Under the tested B25 protocol, learning a compound-supervised readout improves OR-boundary discrimination beyond selecting an atomic-trained readout; assess atomic and AND retention separately.

full_training_sensitivity.endpoint: same bare OR TF/FT-versus-FF pooled AUROC and sample aggregation as original primary
full_training_sensitivity.exposure_note: advantaged atomic exposure includes A identities; exposure, preprocessing and balanced sampling change together; not a pure withholding intervention; S_full uses compound labels; full-training repair was not tested
full_training_sensitivity.positive_and_practical_criteria: apply the same separate positive and .02 practical-gain rules
full_training_sensitivity.required_for: claim that learning advantage survives restored full atomic training
full_training_sensitivity.selection_label_benefit: requires its own positive paired lower bound for S_full minus S_atom_full; descriptive D bank maxima remain fixed optimistic references

gain.below_practical_margin: paired interval upper bound < .02; it does not reach the declared practical margin
gain.practical_unresolved: interval crosses or touches .02, including a positive interval whose lower bound is <= .02 and upper bound is >= .02

inference.compound_row_weights: product of endpoint entity multiplicities; dependent cells and orders share pair weights
inference.frames: separate atomic (294 people) and compound (225 people) frames; never silently replace with a union frame
inference.interval: 95% pointwise percentile, linear quantiles; conditional on frozen fits, selectors and evaluated support
inference.macro: ordinary mean of all five fixed topics; no surviving-topic average
inference.shared_draws: models, methods, samples, wordings and comparisons share draws within their frame
inference.undefined_handling: undefined endpoints/draws remain undefined; no redraw, imputation or topic dropping; preserve valid and invalid counts

interpretation.both_models: both satisfy those checks: replicated claim; this is a conjunction of pointwise results, not simultaneous 95% coverage
interpretation.gain_without_retention_support: report compound improvement without established preservation; distinguish unresolved retention from supported failure
interpretation.invalid_or_unfavorable_outcomes: report undefined, unfavorable, contradictory and inconclusive outcomes; do not choose a favorable subset
interpretation.model_difference: different significance labels alone do not establish a model difference
interpretation.one_model: model-specific support; describe the other outcome explicitly
interpretation.original_primary_success_without_full_ba: retain original result and narrow full-training robustness; report nonpositive, inconclusive or contradictory sensitivity outcomes
interpretation.pooled_success_without_macro_support: describe pooled benefit and qualify dependence on topic weighting
interpretation.required_for_model_supported_claim: positive original-primary gain plus supported atomic and AND retention at pooled and macro scopes for that model; practical magnitude, equal-topic gain and full-training robustness require their separate checks

original_primary.aggregation: ordinary mean of the three per-sample metrics and paired differences within every bootstrap draw; never average or concatenate scores across fitted heads

interpretation_contract.research_question: With a fixed structured compound-supervision allocation, how much does learning a readout add beyond selecting an atomic-trained readout, and does that advantage generalize to held-out entities while retaining atomic and AND discrimination?

resource_accounting.adoption: not performed; recheck current receipts before separately authorized execution; never reset or silently change immutable carryforward pins
resource_accounting.local_accounting_status: available local receipts reconcile; no intervening charge in this campaign found in the inspected roots
resource_accounting.runtime_readiness: actual E runtime, token plans, CUDA memory, persistent two-copy storage reservation, accounting and transfer checks remain required and unmeasured here
resource_accounting.total_seconds_definition: frozen carried model-active charges plus new extraction-worker wall under the existing carry-forward contract; not total project elapsed time, transfer/CPU elapsed time or a forecast

retention.failure: interval upper bound < negative loss margin
retention.interpretation_limit: retention concerns AUROC, not calibration, fixed decisions or model behavior
retention.reference: frozen reduced-training canonical LR evaluated on E
retention.supported: for each endpoint and both scopes, interval lower bound >= negative loss margin
retention.unresolved: interval crosses the negative loss boundary or is undefined; failure is not established

scope.E_generalization: held-out entities within this benchmark, unseen by readout fitting/selection, not necessarily unfamiliar to the pretrained language model
scope.after_E: no fitting, layer/seed/head selection, calibration, threshold change, exclusions or procedure redesign using E; surprising outcomes change claims, not procedures; any discovered bug requires documented review and consistent correction while preserving original results
scope.constituent_limit: decodability does not establish how the model uses the information when answering
scope.deletion_ablation_note: the proposed deletion ablation concerns R_fixed at its fixed layers and budgets, not automatically R_all
omitted_claims: information outside the collective span of the finite bank
sample efficiency or minimum sufficient compound-label budget
scope.support_note: uneven topic support: compound entities animals 16, cities 146, elements 18, inventors 11, Spanish 34; report pooled and macro with topic uncertainty

supervision.allocation: B25: 25 structured pair blocks, five per topic, expanded into 400 dependent compound rows per sample; substantial atomic supervision is disclosed.

topic_weighting.additional_equal_topic_claim: corresponding paired fixed-five-topic macro interval lower bound > 0

resolutions.E_campaign_resource_caps: PROPOSED FOR REVIEW: 7200 seconds/model, 18000 cumulative extraction-worker seconds including frozen carried charges, and 1800 seconds/setup phase; retain the separate 10800-second CPU-job cap. The total is a stopping cap, not a runtime forecast or total project elapsed time. Available local campaign receipts reconcile with frozen carryforward; recheck for intervening charges before any later adoption. No adoption or phase authorization is performed.
resolutions.claim_and_primary_endpoints: PROPOSED FOR REVIEW: test whether, under the fixed structured B25 protocol, learning a compound-supervised readout improves held-out-entity bare OR TF/FT-versus-FF discrimination beyond compound-guided selection of an atomic-trained readout. R_all minus S_all pooled AUROC is the original primary, separately for Qwen and Llama; exclude TT; ordinary mean of samples 11/23/37 within each draw. Positive lower bound >0; practical gain lower bound >.02. Assess atomic and AND retention separately; equal-topic macro qualifies interpretation, not a co-primary.
resolutions.comparator_contrast_approval: PROPOSED FOR REVIEW, NOT FINAL APPROVAL: preserve every frozen contrast. R_all minus S_full separately supports restored-full-atomic-training robustness and cannot rescue an unsuccessful original primary. Preserve S_full minus S_atom_full and R_all minus S_atom_full. Full-training exposure, preprocessing and sampling change together; S_full still uses compound labels and full-training repair was not tested. R_all retention uses the frozen reduced-training canonical LR on E, atomic .005 and AND .02, pooled and macro.
resolutions.joint_atomic_compound_inference: PROPOSED FOR REVIEW: retain separate atomic/compound topic-stratified entity frames and pointwise conditional percentile intervals, 2000 PCG64(1729) shared draws within each frame, endpoint-multiplicity products for compounds, fixed five-topic macro and frozen undefined/1800-finite-draw rules. No joint atomic-compound or simultaneous confidence claim.
